_source_of_truth: The only place the lease auto-sleep's numbers live. The Go reaper mirrors it (tools/exe-reaper/internal/lease, held equal by constants_test.go), the Quint model exe/spec/lease.qnt mirrors it (held equal by tests/unit/test_lease_constants_lockstep.py), and OpenTofu reads it directly. A constant that exists twice is a constant that will disagree once.
_cap_formula: nightly_cap_local_hour = l3_daily_stop_local_hour - (l1_tick_minutes + drain_ceiling_minutes + l2_tick_minutes + slack_minutes), i.e. 04:00 - 60min = 03:00 JST. This is what guarantees L3 never lands on an awake actor in normal operation; both the Go guard and the Quint invariant recompute it rather than trusting the stored 3.
